about: Expected checksums of the sdlc team-registry contract, computed by sdlc 0.32.1.
role and rule: sha256 of the body as UTF-8, written "sha256:<64 hex>".

the concatenation is hashed as UTF-8 and written "sha256:<64 hex>". Content is never normalized.
